linkTypes.title: Activity Ideas
linkTypes.description: A link to ideas for using a product or engaging in other forms of entertainment, particularly with children.

linkTypes.title: Allergen information
linkTypes.description: A link to a description of the allergen information.

linkTypes.title: App download
linkTypes.description: A link to a related mobile app

linkTypes.title: Background Information
linkTypes.description: A link to information typically from the owner of the identified entity about the creative background, thought leadership or influence of the identified entity. This may include the inspiration, innovation for a development process, literary approach or, the science or technology used.

linkTypes.title: Information for professionals about this brand
linkTypes.description: A link to a brand presence aimed at clinical professionals.

linkTypes.title: Information for patients about this brand
linkTypes.description: A link to a brand presence aimed at patients.

linkTypes.title: Careers information
linkTypes.description: A link to information about jobs, careers, or other employment opportunities associated to an organisation or location.

linkTypes.title: Certification Information
linkTypes.description: A link to certification information.

linkTypes.title: Consumer handling and storage information
linkTypes.description: A link to information about safe handling and storage for consumer use.

linkTypes.title: Digital Product Passport
linkTypes.description: A link to a digital product passport.

linkTypes.title: Electronic Instructions For Use
linkTypes.description: A link to electronic Instruction For Use instructions for Medical Devices.

linkTypes.title: EPC Information Services (EPCIS) repository
linkTypes.description: A link to an EPCIS repository of visibility event data.

linkTypes.title: Electronic Patient Information Leaflet
linkTypes.description: A link to an electronic patient information leaflet.

linkTypes.title: Events information
linkTypes.description: A link to event details. For a page specifically for scheduling a reservation or booking an appointment, see gs1:scheduleTime.

linkTypes.title: Frequently Asked Questions
linkTypes.description: A link to a set of frequently asked questions.

linkTypes.title: Handled by
linkTypes.description: Used when one resolver redirects all request URIs that match a given pattern without further processing, such as from GS1 to a brand-operated service. See section 7.7.1 of the Digital Link standard, version 1.1.

linkTypes.title: Has Retailers
linkTypes.description: A link to a list of retailers.

linkTypes.title: Organisation Information Page
linkTypes.description: A link to general information about an organisation or brand. Typically the homepage of an organisation's website. It may include links to further information such as certifications, careers, payments, reservations, etc.

linkTypes.title: Ingredients information
linkTypes.description: A link to facts about ingredients.

linkTypes.title: Instructions
linkTypes.description: A link to instructions, such as assembly instructions, usage tips etc. It is not appropriate to use this link type for healthcare regulated content applications for which specific link types are available.

linkTypes.title: JSON Web Signature
linkTypes.description: A link to a JSON Web Signature

linkTypes.title: Leave a review
linkTypes.description: A link through which a review can be added.

linkTypes.title: Location information
linkTypes.description: A link to a map, directions, or other location-related information. For B2B location information, see gs1:logisticsInfo. For details specific to hours of operation, see gs1:openingHoursInfo

linkTypes.title: Logistics information
linkTypes.description: A link to B2B logistics information related to a physical location.

linkTypes.title: Loyalty program
linkTypes.description: A link to information about a loyalty program, including a member's current status and/or a registration option for new members

linkTypes.title: Master data
linkTypes.description: A link to a source of structured master data for the entity. This is typically for B2B applications.

linkTypes.title: Menu information
linkTypes.description: A link to menu details. This may include food menus, services, or other offerings provided by an organisation or at a location. For details specific to allergens only, see gs1:allergenInfo . For details specific to nutrition information only, see gs1:nutritionalInfo . For details specific to ingredients only, see gs1:ingredientsInfo .

linkTypes.title: Nutritional Information
linkTypes.description: A link to nutritional facts.

linkTypes.title: Opening hours information
linkTypes.description: A link to details on hours of operation.

linkTypes.title: Make Payment
linkTypes.description: A link to a place where payments details are provided and/or payments can be made by the user.

linkTypes.title: Product Information Page
linkTypes.description: A link to information specifically about the identified item, typically operated by the brand owner or a retailer of the product and aimed at consumers. It may include links to further information, product description, specifications etc.

linkTypes.title: Promotion
linkTypes.description: A link to a promotion.

linkTypes.title: Purchase supplies or accessories
linkTypes.description: A link to information about where supplies or accessories for the item can be purchased or ordered.

linkTypes.title: Quick start guide
linkTypes.description: A link to a description of the key features needed to be understood to begin using the item or interacting with something new.

linkTypes.title: Recall status
linkTypes.description: A link to information about whether the product has been recalled or not, typically an API.

linkTypes.title: Recipe website
linkTypes.description: A link to a recipe website.

linkTypes.title: Register purchase
linkTypes.description: A link to an entry point for registering ownership of a product including for warranty purposes.

linkTypes.title: Entry in a register
linkTypes.description: A link to an entry in a register, such as a business register or register of locations. Such registers may act as alternative identifiers, such as official company numbers, LEIs, other location identifiers etc.

linkTypes.title: Related image
linkTypes.description: A link to any image that depicts or relates to the identified entity (e.g., trade item, assets, business process, patient record, location, organisation, etc.)

linkTypes.title: Related video
linkTypes.description: A link to any video, or document that has an embedded video, that describes or relates to the identified item, organisation, or location in some way.

linkTypes.title: Report found
linkTypes.description: A link to a platform or service where users (company or a person) can report a found item associated with the identified entity (instance of an item). This link type is designed to assist in connecting the found item with its rightful owner or relevant authorities.

linkTypes.title: Reviews
linkTypes.description: A link to reviews.

linkTypes.title: Safety information
linkTypes.description: A link to safety information.

linkTypes.title: Scheduling/Reservation
linkTypes.description: A link to a site that offers information on scheduling, appointments, or reservations. This may or may not allow the user to book the reservation.

linkTypes.title: Service information
linkTypes.description: A link to service or maintenance instructions.

linkTypes.title: SmartLabel
linkTypes.description: A link to the product's SmartLabel page.

linkTypes.title: Summary Product Characteristics (SmPC)
linkTypes.description: A link to Summary Product Characteristics. To be used specifically when linking to information for healthcare professionals.

linkTypes.title: Social media
linkTypes.description: A link to a social media channel. The title will typically be replaced by the name of the channel.

linkTypes.title: Statistics
linkTypes.description: A link to information about statistics regarding an organisation, location, or other entity.

linkTypes.title: Subscribe
linkTypes.description: A link to a subscription form

linkTypes.title: Support
linkTypes.description: A link to a source of support such as a helpdesk, chat support, email etc.

linkTypes.title: Sustainability and recycling
linkTypes.description: A link to information relating to sustainability and recycling requirements or processes.

linkTypes.title: Traceability information
linkTypes.description: A link to traceability information (includes track and trace). Traceability information may be provided for consumption by humans or computers. If the target is an EPCIS repository, use gs1:epcis instead.

linkTypes.title: Tutorial
linkTypes.description: A link to a tutorial or set of tutorials, such as online classes, how-to videos etc.

linkTypes.title: Sign waiver/agreement/document
linkTypes.description: A link to an agreement or waiver.

linkTypes.title: Verification Service
linkTypes.description: A link to a GS1 Lightweight Messaging Service for verifying the status of a product, organisation, or location and its identifier.

linkTypes.title: What's in the box?
linkTypes.description: A link to a description of all the individual items in a packaged item.
